Technical Question: Is a 60-120 s cooling interruption on utility failure acceptable for the data hall thermal profile? If not is the solution UPS-backed CHW pumps and CRAH fans thermal storage in the CHW loop or both?
Impact: HIGH - determines whether CRAH fans and CHW pumps move onto the UPS which adds ~305 kW to UPS load and changes UPS sizing from 2500 kW to ~2900 kW per path
Proposed Resolution: Thermal transient analysis of the data hall at 2000 kW with zero airflow; if unacceptable add UPS-backed CRAH fans and secondary CHW pumps and resize UPS

Technical Question: What is the actual impedance of the selected 2500 kVA cast resin transformer and its tolerance band?
Impact: Directly sets prospective fault current currently estimated at 58 kA and therefore the switchboard Icw rating
Proposed Resolution: Obtain vendor technical data sheets for 2-3 candidate units

Technical Question: Does the chilled water ring main have sectionalising valves permitting a section to be isolated while maintaining flow to all CRAHs?
Impact: If not the CHW ring is a mechanical common-mode failure defeating N+1 cooling
Proposed Resolution: Mechanical interface query; require sectionalising valves in the mechanical specification

Technical Question: What is the actual prospective fault current at MSB-A/MSB-B including utility source impedance transformer impedance motor contribution and generator contribution?
Impact: Switchboard Icw rating of 65 kA is currently a judgement not a calculated result
Proposed Resolution: Formal fault level study using ETAP PowerFactory or SKM - outside project scope; document as a limitation

Technical Question: What is the correct design-day dry bulb temperature for the assumed location and what is the actual chiller COP at that condition?
Impact: Changes the 780 kW chiller electrical load which flows through to generator and transformer sizing
Proposed Resolution: Obtain AIRAH or ASHRAE design day data and vendor chiller selection output at that condition

Technical Question: What proportion of the IT load is single-corded and what is its distribution across racks?
Impact: Determines STS quantity and the size of the one genuine gap in the 2N architecture
Proposed Resolution: Requires an IT equipment schedule; assume 5% and flag as a design risk with a stated allowance for growth

Technical Question: Are two independent 11 kV feeders from separate zone substations actually available at 5 MVA each and what are the network fault levels and protection requirements?
Impact: If only one feeder is available the utility becomes a documented single point of failure and the generator strategy must change
Proposed Resolution: Formal supply application to the DNSP - outside project scope; document as an assumption

Technical Question: What is the automatic load shedding hierarchy and its trigger logic for the double-contingency overload cases identified in the BoD?
Impact: Without it the documented overload scenarios have no mitigation
Proposed Resolution: Develop a load shedding schedule in Week 6 with the controls philosophy; sequence non-essential boards then mechanical N+1 standby then mechanical setpoint relaxation

Technical Question: How is wet stacking avoided given both sets per path run at only 36% in normal split operation on generator?
Proposed Resolution: Run one set per path for normal split load and auto-start the second on demand or for path takeover; define in the controls philosophy and provide load bank connections

Technical Question: What is the actual specific fuel consumption of the selected 2400 kW set across the load range?
Impact: Changes bulk fuel tank volume currently 2 x 25000 L

Issue: UPS frame rating at design limit
Technical Question: Should the UPS be 2 x 1500 kW frames per path (3000 kW per path 67% single-path loading) rather than 2 x 1250 kW (2500 kW per path 80% loading)?
Impact: 80% leaves no headroom for load growth or measurement error at the worst-case condition
Proposed Resolution: Design review decision; note that TQ-001 may force an increase anyway if CRAH fans move onto UPS

Technical Question: What are the fire detection suppression ventilation and thermal runaway containment requirements for a 480 kWh LFP battery room?
Impact: Safety-critical and may affect room sizing and location
Proposed Resolution: Requires specialist fire engineering input and standards verification - outside project scope; document as a limitation

Technical Question: 8 kW at 240 V is 33.3 A which exceeds a 32 A single-phase rack PDU. Confirm standardisation on 32 A 3-phase.
Impact: Sizing error caught in Week 1; affects 500 rack PDUs
Proposed Resolution: Adopt DDR-013 - standardise on 32 A 3-phase rack PDUs throughout

Technical Question: How long must the utility be proven stable before automatic retransfer from generator?
Impact: Operational only; too short risks repeated transfers on an unstable network
Proposed Resolution: Assume 5 minutes; confirm against DNSP network reliability data and operator preference

Technical Question: What is the required Ah capacity and autonomy of the per-path 110 V DC control supply and does it support a full black start sequence?
Impact: Black start capability - a circular dependency here would prevent facility recovery from total shutdown
Proposed Resolution: Develop DC load schedule and verify against black start sequence in Week 4 operating scenario 15
